caveats: The cohort omits four new 2024 authorities and Mother Earth in 2023; it is not a province-wide total.
Restatements and PSAS policy changes limit interpreting this as a harmonized resource trend or causal effect.
Valhalla has a fundraising-completeness qualification; its monetary effect is unknown.
Purchased-intangible amortization is zero in both periods. Blank comparative cells are treated as zero; that fact does not bound all capitalization effects.
Source rounding is retained by using printed totals.
